bottom_line: In SHIFT, ivabradine versus placebo reduced the primary composite of cardiovascular death or hospital admission for worsening heart failure (HR 0.82, 95% CI 0.75–0.90).
implications: In this population, ivabradine (titrated up to 7.5 mg twice daily) versus placebo was associated with fewer primary composite events (HR 0.82, 95% CI 0.75–0.90), mainly via fewer hospital admissions for worsening heart failure (HR 0.74, 95% CI 0.66–0.83), with a reduction in death from heart failure (HR 0.74, 95% CI 0.58–0.94) but no statistically significant reduction in all-cause mortality (HR 0.90, 95% CI 0.80–1.02; p=0.092). The safety profile in this report includes higher symptomatic bradycardia and phosphenes with ivabradine.

major_points.text: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group trial in symptomatic chronic heart failure with LVEF ≤35% and sinus rhythm with HR ≥70 bpm.
major_points.quote: Patients were eligible for participation in this randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group study if they had symptomatic heart failure and a left-ventricular ejection fraction of 35% or lower, were in sinus rhythm with heart rate 70 beats per min or higher

major_points.text: Primary endpoint was composite of cardiovascular death or hospital admission for worsening heart failure; analysis was intention to treat.
major_points.quote: The primary endpoint was the composite of cardiovascular death or hospital admission for worsening heart failure. Analysis was by intention to treat.

major_points.text: Primary endpoint occurred in 24% with ivabradine vs 29% with placebo, HR 0.82 (95% CI 0.75–0.90).
major_points.quote: 793 (24%) patients in the ivabradine group and 937 (29%) of those taking placebo had a primary endpoint event (HR 0·82, 95% CI 0·75–0·90, p<0·0001).

major_points.text: Effect was mainly driven by fewer hospital admissions for worsening heart failure (HR 0.74, 95% CI 0.66–0.83).
major_points.quote: hospital admissions for worsening heart failure (672 [21%] placebo vs 514 [16%] ivabradine; HR 0·74, 0·66–0·83; p<0·0001)

major_points.text: Deaths due to heart failure were reduced (HR 0.74, 95% CI 0.58–0.94).
major_points.quote: deaths due to heart failure (151 [5%] vs 113 [3%]; HR 0·74, 0·58–0·94, p=0·014).

major_points.text: Symptomatic bradycardia was more frequent with ivabradine (5% vs 1%).
major_points.quote: 150 (5%) of ivabradine patients had symptomatic bradycardia compared with 32 (1%) of the placebo group (p<0·0001).

major_points.text: Visual side-effects (phosphenes) were more common with ivabradine (3% vs 1%).
major_points.quote: Visual side-eﬀects (phosphenes) were reported by 89 (3%) of patients on ivabradine and 17 (1%) on placebo (p<0·0001).
